issues: Successes: service and food quality, store management, communication, food presentation and the omakase.
Areas to improve: service standards, compliance, upselling and cleaning.
Labour cost came down with the new closing hours, and training is ongoing.
Hygiene checks were 100% compliant and all waste was tracked.
Pest problems continue and pest control is monitoring, and deep cleaning is arranged for the coming days.
The new omakase material is not ready yet, and reviews need to improve.
Ziang Lin stressed cutting FOH and BOH labour when quiet, and Nori staff must not work downstairs unless salaried (London KPI meeting 10/11).
Matthew Alderson-Jenner said Nori closes on 30/11 (Admin Meeting 09/11).
Promotions: omakase nights Wednesday to Friday and the lunch promo, with materials on the tables and posters in the window.

The Nori kitchen refit will reuse the existing three door fridge for the cook line instead of buying new drawers and a separate fridge, with a teppanyaki, a four ring wok and a ramen boiler still to buy (AM Updates meeting 11/11).
